'''Dajan-Ko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Dajan-Ko raised his grandson [[Gaden-Ko]] and noticed the young Gaden-Ko's uncanny intuition, that marked him as a potential Mystic visionary. Dajan-Ko accompanied Gaden-Ko to the [[Holy Path of Mir]] as part of his pilgrimage to become a [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by [[shaclaw]]s. Dajan-Ko later appeared in a vision to observe his grandson and judged his valor. At the end of the training Dajan congratulated with Gaden and approved his decision to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
